verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's MCP server lets a connected AI agent query live telemetry to 'investigate and diagnose latency or error spikes' and 'identify performance outliers and suggest optimization opportunities,' which supports AI-driven root-cause style investigation, and Query Assistant provides NLQ-based query generation for investigation. However this requires bringing your own external AI agent rather than a built-in first-party 'root cause' engine, and there's no evidence of automatic alert-to-root-cause proposals triggered directly from Honeycomb's own alerting (triggers/SLOs) without a separate MCP client. Missing for 10: a native, first-party AI that autonomously investigates fired alerts and outputs a root-cause hypothesis without external agent setup, and independent/hands-on validation of investigation accuracy.
